description: The statuses each compare-and-set task write accepts, the same in the Node core and the Python core (batch 27 KTD7, KTD8). A write to a row in any other status writes nothing. `actions`: the user actions, driven through each core's public API on a ledger row in each of `statuses`. `races`: an action whose read is stale (the row was `read`, then another process wrote `ledger`): `refused` raises and leaves the ledger row as the other process wrote it; `returns_ledger_row` returns that row. Read by packages/core-ts/test/task-transition-guards.test.ts and packages/core-py/tests/test_task_transitions.py.
